test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who was the first female judge of the Supreme Court in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M Fathima Beevi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first female judge **of the **Supreme Court **of India was **Fathima Beevi.**
 
• She was appointed on **6 October 1989.**
 
• So far, **no woman **has been appointed as the **Chief Justice of India. **
 
• As per seniority, **B. V. Nagarathna** is assumed to become the **first female** **Chief Justice of India in 2027. **
 
• **Leila Seth** was an Indian judge who served as the** first woman judge **on the** Delhi High Court **and later, she became the** first woman Chief Justice of a state High Court**, **Himachal Pradesh High Court**, on** 5 August 1991. **
 
• Recently on** 24th January 2022, Ayesha A. Malik **took the oath to become the **first female judge of the Supreme Court of Pakistan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **R Banumathi **is the 6th female Judge in the Supreme Court of India.
 
• **Sujatha V Manohar **is the 2nd female Judge in the Supreme Court of India.
 
• **Indira Banerjee** is the 8th female Judge in the Supreme Court of India.
